title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jjhj: schc/fragment.rs check_rule uses matches! with non-const-pattern constants
description: Line 84: `matches!(rule_id, RULE_ID_A_TO_B | RULE_ID_B_TO_A)` treats the RHS as binding patterns, not constant patterns. Unqualified names in matches! are always binding patterns. Fix: use qualified path `Path::to::RULE_ID_A_TO_B` or replace with `rule_id == RULE_ID_A_TO_B || rule_id == RULE_ID_B_TO_A` or use `#[allow(non_upper_case_globals)]` + let-binding trick.
